# TurfCalc.au

> Free, independent turf calculator and lawn guides for Australian homeowners. Work out how much turf (m²), soil, mulch or gravel (m³) you need, what it costs in Australia, and how to lay and care for a new lawn. Not affiliated with any turf supplier.

## Calculators
- [Turf calculator](https://turfcalculator.com.au/): area in m² from lawn shapes, wastage allowance, pallets and estimated cost
- [Soil, mulch & gravel calculator](https://turfcalculator.com.au/soil-mulch-gravel-calculator): cubic metres and bags from area and depth

## Core guides
- [How much turf do I need?](https://turfcalculator.com.au/how-much-turf-do-i-need): worked examples in m² with wastage
- [How to measure your lawn](https://turfcalculator.com.au/how-to-measure-your-lawn): measuring rectangles, curves and odd shapes
- [Turf prices in Australia](https://turfcalculator.com.au/turf-prices-australia): cost per m² by variety
- [Turf prices in Sydney](https://turfcalculator.com.au/turf-prices-sydney): Sydney cost per m² by variety
- [How to lay turf](https://turfcalculator.com.au/how-to-lay-turf): ground preparation, laying and watering in
- [Turf types in Australia](https://turfcalculator.com.au/turf-types-australia): buffalo, kikuyu, couch and zoysia compared

## Guides
- [All guides](https://turfcalculator.com.au/guides/)
